meaning: Unpack N1 at a represented law entity, then unpack its concrete instance-derived location to recover an existing bearer and its instantiation. A checked companion excludes existing uninstantiated law representatives. This is conditional on the selected representation/location profile, not an independent defense of immanent universals or the truth of N1.

strong_version_needed.STMT-NATURALISM-N1: The theorem ranges over existing law representatives without a supplied concreteness predicate. N2 would need an additional classification of those entities as concrete; no all-existing-concrete bridge is silently assumed. This is an N1 occupant profile, not a claim about all naturalist variants.
